div.p: This case-insensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-provenance-activity-cs defines the following codes in a Grouped By hierarchy:

tr.td: Activity that removes all personally identifiable information (PII) to prevent re-identification.
Activity that removes or obfuscates personal identifiers while retaining data usability.
Activity that hides or replaces specific data elements with placeholder values.
Activity that applies confidentiality, sensitivity, or purpose-of-use labels to data.
Activity that replaces direct identifiers with pseudonyms that can be re-linked under controlled conditions.
Activity representing the creation of new data or resource instance.
Activity representing deletion or removal of a data record.
Activity representing addition of new information to an existing resource or record.
Activity that invalidates or renders data non-usable without deleting the record.
Activity confirming legal authentication of a record (e.g., signed or witnessed by authorized person).

description.value: Local CodeSystem defining provenance activity codes for data lifecycle operations such as anonymization, de-identification, labeling, creation, and deletion.
